answer: Re-attestations are stored in vertex and yarrow lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the jade graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1665 impostors cost 388 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
